title: comp(U)s(I)tion (BFA Capstone #1)
description:
My defining senior thesis and capstone project.

PLA Filament, FDM 3D Printing, Camera, Electronics, Touchdesigner.

Examines the misconception that machines exist separately from humanity. Comp(u)s(i)tion highlights how machines are shaped by human biases, beliefs, and systems, making them inseparable from the human experience. Through interactive engagement, the piece reflects on the ways people influence and are influenced by technology. Rather than positioning machines as autonomous entities, the work presents them as extensions of human interactions. By making audience presence an integral part of the piece, it encourages reflection on agency, perception, and the evolving dynamic between humanity and technology. Technology is not a distant or fixed force—it is built through human conversations and choices, and just as it is made, it can be changed for the better.
